description: This is a test module for verifying the functionality of the InMemoryAuditLogRepository class and related audit event behaviors. It contains unit tests that validate appending events, ensuring fields are correctly set, and confirming timestamp types.

classes.name: InMemoryAuditLogRepository
classes.description: A test double class for storing audit log events in memory, used for unit testing purposes.

methods.name: test_in_memory_audit_repo_appends_and_is_append_only()
methods.description: Tests that appending events to the in-memory repository works correctly and that the events have the expected common fields and payload hash.

methods.name: test_audit_event_timestamp_is_datetime()
methods.description: Verifies that the timestamp of the audit event is a datetime object.
